row.notes: Perk-tree node completion (facility upgrades and the other perk trees): if node+0x08 == 1 and vtable+0x20 (isComplete: days_remaining +0xac == 0 and purchased +0xb0) -> node+0x08 = 2, vtable+0x38 (claim rewards; facility nodes: 0x140f8d8d0, posts MessageFacilityUpgradeComplete), then each child in +0x20..+0x28 (16-byte shared_ptrs) with state 0 whose vtable+0x18 passes -> state 1 and vtable+0x30. Returns 1 when it completed. Called by the facility daily tick when days_remaining reaches 0 and by the unlock-at-start pass 0x140f8a1a0.
